title: Family in Town
why: Thanksgiving-visitor angle for locals hosting family: a reason to get everybody out of the house without a road trip.
hook_options: The family is in town. Now what?
Get everyone off the couch for two hours
caption: Family lands Wednesday. By Friday everybody is full, restless, and on their phones. Two hours on Bayou Bienvenue, fifteen minutes from the Quarter: private boat for the whole crew, or the eco tour if the kids are coming. #neworleans #thanksgiving #nolapartybarge #familytrip

slides.headline: The family is in town. Now what?
Everyone is full, restless, and on their phones
slides.body: Somebody suggests a movie. Somebody else suggests a nap. Your uncle suggests Bourbon Street.

slides.headline: Two hours on the bayou, 15 minutes away
slides.body: Get everybody out of the house and onto the water without a road trip.

slides.headline: Book the whole boat
slides.body: Private boats hold 18 to 25. Your family only, your food, your drinks, your music.

slides.headline: The eco tour welcomes all ages
slides.body: Slower boat, quieter ride, a captain who talks wildlife and coastal land loss. Restroom on board.

slides.headline: Egrets, herons, maybe a gator
slides.body: Wildlife is common, not guaranteed. Gators slow down when it turns cold, so late November is hit or miss.

slides.headline: Bring a jacket for the ride back
slides.body: The deck is covered, but evenings on open water can run cooler than the Quarter.

slides.headline: Pack the leftovers. It is BYOB.
slides.body: Turkey sandwiches, pie, the good wine nobody opened. Bring it all aboard.

slides.headline: Holiday weekends go first
slides.body: If the family lands Wednesday, pick your date before they do.

slides.kicker: Send this to whoever is hosting
slides.headline: Give them a reason to leave the couch
slides.body: Private boats, shared seats, or the eco tour. nolapartybarges.com
